title: Nametag flicker: which part causes it?
intro: Co-op starts by itself. Don't move; just watch the pawn nametags in each step and remember the step number where the flicker stops.

steps.text: Hands off - starting co-op. Stand near the pawns.
WATCH: DPC camera block switched OFF
WATCH: DPC controller zeroing also OFF
Both back ON. Open the REFramework menu > Camera Distance > untick 'Keep player 2's pawn on screen', close the menu
Tick 'Keep player 2's pawn on screen' again

probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active
probes.ascr: local p=H.arisen():call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
